evals.name: TSDoc Documentation & Function Parameter DTO Refactoring
evals.prompt: Refactor a legacy calculation function with 5 positional arguments and zero comments into an encapsulated typed DTO and complete TSDoc block documentation.
evals.expected_output: Creates typed options interface, reduces function signature to single parameter, and documents purpose, @param, @returns, and @throws.
assertions: Encapsulates 4+ parameters into a typed DTO interface or options object
Reduces positional function parameters to at most 3
Adds comprehensive TSDoc comment with @param, @returns, and @throws tags
Includes a realistic @example usage snippet in documentation

evals.name: Elimination of Explicit any & Type Narrowing
evals.prompt: Refactor an untrusted webhook handler that uses explicit any types into strict TypeScript with unknown and user-defined type guards.
evals.expected_output: Eliminates all any types, validates payload using a type guard predicate, and safely accesses typed properties.
assertions: Eliminates explicit 'any' type annotations from function signature
Implements a user-defined type guard returning 'value is PayloadType'
Safely handles invalid payloads by throwing descriptive domain errors

evals.name: Guard Clause Extraction & Flattening Deeply Nested Conditionals
evals.prompt: Refactor a deeply nested if/else payment processing method (3+ levels) into clean guard clauses with early returns.
evals.expected_output: Flattens conditional pyramid using early returns or early throws, keeping nesting depth strictly <= 2 levels.
assertions: Replaces nested if/else statements with precondition guard clauses
Reduces maximum conditional nesting depth to at most 2 levels
Throws domain exceptions immediately upon invalid precondition states
Maintains happy path execution at the lowest indentation level
